topic: Seminar, vendor and bar-height folding tables
summary: Folding table sizes: 6 ft seminar table 72 x 18 in, 29 in high (1.83 x 0.46 x 0.74 m); 6 ft fold-in-half table 72 x 29.5 in; 8 ft banquet table 96 x 30 in, 29 in high; 32 in round bar-height table 43.3 in high (0.81 m across, 1.10 m high). The library's classroom table uses the seminar size. The existing 8 ft banquet and cocktail table pieces already exist (the cocktail table is 0.76 x 1.07 m, so the 32 in size differs a little; not changed here).
